A FEW USEFUL ANSWERS

Before we
get started.

Can I request on-site and remote support?

Yes. Send the location, equipment details and issue. We'll confirm the available delivery option and timing before booking.

Do you support one-off projects?

You can discuss a single support task, a rollout or an ongoing support requirement. Scope and pricing are agreed for your specific request.

Can you work with our existing IT team?

We can scope smart hands, site assistance, installations and project support alongside your internal or remote technical team.

What should I include in my inquiry?

Include your service, location, equipment or systems involved, a brief description and preferred timeline. Please do not send passwords or other confidential credentials.

Is round-the-clock support available?

For out-of-hours or service desk coverage, contact us to discuss the required schedule. Coverage and response arrangements must be confirmed in your service agreement.
